timeline.text: A hundred features. Five repos. And I couldn't remember where any of them came from.
Verifying one feature meant fifteen to thirty minutes of digging through commit histories by hand.
It was like reading a stranger's diary hoping to find the one page that mattered.
A GitHub Action now scans every repo and links each feature straight to its commit.
What took thirty minutes now takes seconds — investigation time down ninety-five percent.
